# Markedet tynges af bekymringer - hvad kan vende stemningen?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode (Euroinvestor) features Michael Friis Jørgensen of HC Andersen Capital and Josefine Setti of Nordea. They discuss a correction of more than 10% driven by AI and semiconductor worries, expected Fed rate hikes and renewed US tariff threats. Both see no recession in the data and suggest averaging into the market slowly. The December Fed meeting and the coming earnings reports are named as possible catalysts. They warn that the rotation into defensives such as pharma and consumer staples has become stretched on valuation, while Danish and defensive stocks have held up as anti-AI trades.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michael (guest) bought NKT as a lower-risk AI-adjacent energy-buildout play while it is out of favour.

#### Reasoning

Michael Friis bought NKT and Vestas as an alternative to chips. He sees the AI trade as having swung too far in the sell-off. He argues there are enough chips but not enough energy, and that the energy buildout has drivers beyond AI. It is a deliberate 'handbrake half-on' position and he is only dipping his toes in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the energy buildout slows alongside AI capex
- if datacenter construction regulation in the US tightens sharply
- if the broader market enters a bear market or recession

> *"Ja, det er det, fordi det er NKT og Vestas, så de er jo AI-trade-aktier. Altså energi."*

---

### 🟢 VWS — Vestas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michael (guest) bought Vestas together with NKT as an energy-buildout play.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis as NKT: the world may have enough chips but not enough energy. Energy stocks were sold off with the AI trade but have independent drivers, so this is a lower-beta way to play an AI rebound. Michael is buying gradually.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the energy sector keeps falling with AI names without a fundamental reason
- if the AI capex slowdown hits energy demand
- if new tariffs hurt the renewables supply chain

> *"Så det kunne også blive en faktor, der gør, at vi måske ikke skal op med chipsektoren, men måske skal vi op med energisektoren."*

---

### 🟠 ROCK B — Rockwool | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Michael notes investors are speculating into today's report on lower energy input prices.

#### Reasoning

Michael observed others buying into Rockwool ahead of its report, betting that falling energy prices lower input costs and that guidance will point to good prices. This is a description of what the market is doing, not a personal recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report disappoints on pricing or guidance
- if energy prices rebound

> *"Jeg kan også se folk prøve at købe sig lidt ind i Rockwool-regnskabet her, der kommer i eftermiddag."*

---

### ⛔ DEMANT — Demant | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell after the CMD. Michael frames the hearing-aid sector as cyclical on product launches, and a competitor is starting a new cycle.

#### Reasoning

Michael says Demant gave a weak message at its capital markets day while estimates had run ahead. With competitors launching new products, investors are leaving the stock, and he expects the sector to trade on product cycles. The view is implied rather than stated as a recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a new Demant product launch starts a fresh sales cycle
- if 2026-27 estimates hold up

> *"de leverer ikke et fuldstændig stærkt budskab på kapitalmarkedsdagen"*

---

### 🟠 MU — Micron | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Market fades strong results on fears that memory prices and margins peak by 2027. Michael draws a Maersk peak-earnings analogy.

#### Reasoning

Micron's margin jumped from 2.5% to 40% on prices, not volume. If prices fall, earnings vanish, so a low P/E may be misleading. Michael is waiting for analysts to cut estimates before turning constructive. He calls it a price-discovery phase.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory prices fall faster than expected
- if 2027 estimates are cut heavily

> *"Micron havde 2,5 procent i marginen, nu har de 40 procent."*
